# Explorable ruins

## In short
- Entering an explorable ruin costs 1 AP. You can't enter if you are wounded, terrorised, over-encumbered or escorting citizens, if someone else is exploring, or if you already explored that day. The zone must be under control unless you wear the Camouflage Vest [1].
- Your oxygen lasts 5 minutes, or 7 min 30 s for a Scavenger. A 30-second pause before your first move doesn't count. If oxygen runs out, you are wounded and drop everything non-essential in your bag [2] [3].
- Each room can be searched once per exploration. The first search of a room has about 87% success, and the chance drops with each item already found in that room. Scavengers search better [4].
- Zombies block corridors. Fleeing costs 15–24 s of oxygen, and so does every change of floor [5].

## How it works
**Placement and layout**
- Default towns have 1 explorable ruin [6].
- It is placed between the ruin type's minimum distance and `ERuinMaxDistanceFromTown`, which is 10 km by default [7] [8]. The cards give 5–100 km as the range for Bunker, Hospital and Hotel [9].
- Default layout settings: 2 floors on a 13×13 grid, 15 rooms in total with at least 5 per floor, rooms at a corridor distance of more than 5, at least 4 apart from each other, and locked if their distance is more than 10 [8] [10].
- On the ground floor, the first 2 rooms are placed between distance 5 and 10. The last room of a floor is placed within 2 of the floor's maximum distance [10].
- The stairs to the next floor are placed beyond the lock distance [10].
- Bunker stairs lead down; other ruins' stairs lead up [11].

**Entering**
- All the conditions in "In short" apply. You also need at least 1 AP and must not be tired [1].
- On entry:
  - you pay 1 AP and get the `r_ruine_#00` picto;
  - your dig timer becomes passive;
  - your escort settings are removed;
  - the zone is marked as scavenged [1].
- Oxygen timeout = exploration time (normal or Scavenger) + `OxygenTimeBonus` seconds + 30 s [1].
- **Grace period:** on your first move, the timeout loses (30 − seconds already spent, capped at 0–30). In practice the 30 s only lasts until you start moving, and the timer is shown as paused until then [5].
- Explorer records are deleted at dawn, so each citizen can explore again the next day [12].

**Moving**
- Each action is one step: along a corridor, up or down a stair, or into or out of a room [5].
- Inside a room you can only leave it.
- A locked door can't be entered.
- Changing floor costs a random 15–24 s of oxygen.

**Zombies**
- If your current cell has zombies, you can't move unless you flee. Fleeing costs 15–24 s of oxygen [5].
- The escape state ends on any corridor or floor move, or when you leave a room. Entering a room keeps it.
- At creation the ruin gets 10 zombies × number of floors, so 20 by default [8] [10].
- Zombies go on random corridor cells, never on the entrance, with at most 4 per cell [10].
- Every dawn, all corpses are cleared and all zombies are collected and placed again, plus `ERuinZombiesDaily` (5) × `getExplorableFloorFactor`. That factor is min(1, floors), so the nightly addition is 5 zombies [12] [13].
- Inside a ruin, kill effects hit the current ruin cell: kills = min(zombies, random(min, max)), and each kill gives the `r_killz_#00` picto [14].
- Escape effects used inside a ruin move all zombies of your cell to other cells [14].

**Searching a room**
- You must be inside a room you haven't searched during this exploration [15].
- Chance = (1 + job dig bonus) / (1 + d / max(1, 7 − d/3)), where d = items already found in this room + 1, and 7 is the item fill rate. The result is clamped to 0–1 [4].
- That gives about 87%, 76%, 67% and 59% for a room with 0, 1, 2 and 3 previous finds (my own calculation).
- There is no night penalty for ruin searches [4].
- On success the room's find counter goes up by 1. The item goes into your bag, or onto the floor of the ruin cell if your bag is full [15].

**Items found**
- Items are drawn from the ruin type's drop group [16]. The cards list these drops:
  - **Bunker:** blueprints at 12% uncommon / 5.8% rare / 2.9% very rare; Bump Key, Bottle Opener and Magnetic Key at 2.4% each [9].
  - **Hospital:** blueprints at 11% / 5.7% / 2.9% [17].
  - **Hotel:** blueprints at 12% / 5.8% / 2.9% [18].
- Items with the `found_poisoned` property are poisoned 90% of the time when found in an explorable ruin [16].
- Items with a town-wide find limit are redrawn, up to 10 times, once the limit is reached [16].
- Each ruin type has its own lists of blueprints, by level 2–4 [8].

**Locked doors**
- **Taking an imprint** happens from the corridor, not inside the room. The door must be locked and not yet marked as used in this exploration [5].
  - The normal imprint needs 1 free bag slot.
  - The alternative imprint consumes Chinese Noodles (`food_noodles_#00`) / Pharmaceutical Products (`pharma_#00`).
  - Either way, the door is then marked as used for this exploration.
- **Opening a door** consumes the matching key item and unlocks the door for good. It gives the `r_door_#00` picto and clears the door's "used" mark, so the room can then be searched [5].

**Leaving and running out of oxygen**
- You can only leave normally from the entrance cell [5].
- When oxygen runs out, the check runs on your next action. All non-essential bag items are dropped on the floor of your current ruin cell, you are wounded, and you are thrown out of the ruin [3].

## What changes it
- **Scavenger (`collec`):**
  - 7 min 30 s of oxygen instead of 5 min [2].
  - +0.2 dig bonus, which multiplies the search chance by 1.2. For example the first search of a room becomes 100% after clamping [list_entities profession] [4].
- **Technician (`tech`):** the dashboard offers the key imprint for locked doors [15].
- **Tamer:** gets an arrow pointing to the exit, or to the stair back toward the ground floor [5].
- **Scout / Camouflage Vest (`vest_on_#00`):** lets you enter even when the zone is not under control [1].
- **Guide role:** shows an "activity" indicator, 0.1 + 0.9 × (4 − min(4, room distance))/4, that tells how close a room is [5].
- **Statuses:**
  - `wound5` (eye injury): −20% search chance.
  - `drunk`: −20% search chance [4].
  - Wounded or `terror`: can't enter [1].
- **Hero skill Enduring:**
  - level 2 (40 hero days): +45 s oxygen [19];
  - level 3 (80 hero days): +90 s oxygen [20];
  - levels 0 and 1 give no oxygen bonus [21].
- **Weapons and escape items** used inside: see the Zombies part above [14].

## Town types
- **Default and remote:** the default values above apply. Remote towns change nothing about ruins [22].
- **Small:** the explorable-ruin settings are unchanged; only the map (12–14) and the number of normal ruins (7) differ [23].
- **Panda (Pandemonium):** [24]
  - normal oxygen time is 3 min 30 s instead of 5 min;
  - the ruin can be up to 100 km from town;
  - the blueprint lists are different.
- **Custom:** these settings require the Crow permission level, otherwise they are trimmed [25]:
  - more than 3 floors (clamped to 3);
  - more than 20 rooms (clamped to 20);
  - a ruin size other than 13×13 (reset);
  - more than 3 explorable ruins (clamped to 3);
  - changed exploration times.

## Related
- Desert digging and searching normal buildings use the same chance function [26].
- Zone control and the nightly zombie spread outside [27].
- Ruin blueprints found by camping [28].

## Not verified
- Whether the alternative imprint needs both Chinese Noodles and Pharmaceutical Products, or either one. The code fetches both prototypes, but I didn't read how `fetchSpecificItems` matches them.
- The normal imprint doesn't check the Technician job on the server side; only the dashboard offers it to Technicians.
- The nightly zombie factor `min(1, floors)` always gives 5 zombies for any ruin with at least one floor. It looks like it may be meant as `max`, but the code says `min`.
- The exact distance range for each explorable ruin type, beyond what the cards show.
